memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: God blessed them and said, "Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the water in the seas, and let the birds increase on the earth." - Gen 1:22 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
For the first time in the creation account, God speaks a blessing. He has made the fish and the birds, and now He blesses them, commanding them to be fruitful, to increase, and to fill the seas and the skies. God does not simply make life and step back; He blesses it and gives it the power to flourish and multiply.

This tells us something warm about our God. He is not stingy or reluctant. His heart is to bless, to give, to see life thrive and grow. The very first thing He does after making these creatures is to bless them. Blessing flows naturally from His generous heart.

And see how the blessing works, it enables the creatures to do what God has called them to do. God's blessing is not just a nice word; it carries the power to fulfil His purpose. When God blesses, He also enables.

The same is true for us. God does not call us to a task and then leave us on our own. When He gives us something to do, He supplies what we need to do it. His grace equips us for every good work He has prepared (2 Cor 9:8). Whatever God has called you to today, remember that His blessing rests on His purposes. Ask Him for the grace to be fruitful right where He has placed you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where do you need to trust that God's blessing will enable you to fulfil His purpose?
2. Do you tend to see God as reluctant, or as generous and eager to bless?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You are generous and delight to bless. Thank You that when You call me to something, You also enable me for it. Help me be fruitful for You today. Amen.
